title: GravityOrg – Club Portfolio Website
description: Developed a responsive and visually engaging club portfolio website to showcase events, achievements, and organizational culture. Designed a clean, modern UI with structured navigation to ensure an intuitive user experience across devices.

title: Digital Student Care Network
description: Developed a student support chatbot using Flask and Google Gemini AI to provide empathetic, real-time responses to academic and emotional queries. Integrated secure API endpoints for chat interactions with proper JSON validation and error handling.

title: Expense Tracker
description: Built a web-based expense tracking application to manage daily spending with a simple and intuitive UI. Implemented features for adding, deleting, and categorizing expenses with real-time updates.

title: QR Code Generator
description: Developed a QR code generator that allows users to quickly convert text or URLs into scannable QR codes. Focused on speed, simplicity, and responsive design.

title: Habit Tracker
description: Created a habit tracking application to help users build and maintain daily routines. Included features like progress tracking and simple visual indicators for consistency.

title: Online Examination System
description: Built an online examination platform with structured question flow and result evaluation. Designed to simulate real exam environments with user-friendly navigation.

title: TV Channels Streaming UI
description: Developed a frontend interface for browsing and streaming TV channels. Focused on layout design, content organization, and smooth user experience.

title: E-commerce Website
description: Created a basic e-commerce frontend with product listings, navigation, and UI components. Emphasized clean design and usability for online shopping experiences.
